summary_en: SG Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 11.0 million shares (1.84% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥15.0 billion through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 9, 2026 through February 26, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency under its progressive dividend and capital allocation policy.
title_en: Notice on Decisions Regarding Repurchase of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
SG Holdings' board resolved on November 6, 2026 to authorize the repurchase of up to 11.0 million shares of its own common stock, representing 1.84% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total expenditure of ¥15.0 billion. The buyback will be executed through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 9, 2026 and February 26, 2027. The company may not acquire all shares or spend the full amount depending on market conditions.

The company positions share repurchase as a key shareholder return mechanism alongside its progressive dividend policy. Under the current medium-term business plan, the company targets a three-year cumulative total payout ratio of 60% or higher, combining semi-annual dividend distributions with discretionary treasury stock acquisitions. The repurchase addresses two objectives: strengthening shareholder returns and improving capital efficiency. The maximum acquisition price and the execution schedule were determined after comprehensive consideration of the company's financial condition and shareholder return policy.
